outcome: facility readiness to manage common obstetric emergencies
cohort: The study included 23 hospitals (10 designated comprehensive emergency obstetric care facilities) in Migori County, western Kenya, and Busoga Region, eastern Uganda.
finding: The signal functions overestimated practical emergency readiness by 23 percentage points compared to the clinical cascade model, with a 28% pooled mean drop-off in readiness across the three stages of care for common obstetric emergencies.
